主要内容: The Genesis G70 ranked first in J.D. Power's 2019 Multimedia Quality and Satisfaction Study among compact premium cars and SUVs, achieving 7.4 PP100, 28% fewer issues than competitors. In the 2019 IQS study, Genesis vehicles saw 63 PP100, 32% fewer than the industry standard and 25% fewer than the runner-up premium brand. Erwin Raphael, COO of Genesis Motor America, stated that technological innovation is a key customer purchase reason, and the award reinforces the brand's commitment to delivering quality ownership experiences. The IQS study, now in its fourth decade, measures new-vehicle quality at 90 days of ownership. Genesis, a global luxury brand, offers enhanced warranty and roadside assistance. The G70 was named 2019 North American Car of the Year and won multiple awards, including Car and Driver 10Best. For more details, visit www.genesis.com or www.genesisnewsusa.com.
